newsitem.title: USA: Net $1.88 bln of U.S. securities stripped in July.
newsitem.headline: Net $1.88 bln of U.S. securities stripped in July.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that a net $1.88 billion of U.S. securities were stripped in July, compared with $1.57 billion stripped in June.

Strips, or Separate Trading of Registered Interest and Principal of Securities program, are created by separating the interest coupon from the principal payment. Securities can also be reconstituted by rejoining the principal and interest.
Treasury said $980.061 billion of securities were eligible for stripping in July. Of the total, $230.945 billion were held in stripped form on July 31, up from $229.070 billion on June 30.
